name: nonoun-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins: the harness/docs authoring toolchain, and five domain plugins (agent-protocols, llm, design, screens, teamwork) partitioned from a legacy personal skill/agent corpus.

plugins.name: agent-protocols
plugins.description: A2UI knowledge packs — wire protocol/renderer, catalog design, the live conversational agent, and the training corpus — answering how @agent-ui/a2ui works from a cited repo corpus; named agent-protocols (not a2ui) to leave room for future Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol material.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: The design plugin — color science and OKLCH palettes, the 11-voice typography system, Material Design token grammar, and the design-system export bundles (Claude Design/DESIGN.md, Figma Make, Google Stitch) a generative design agent consumes.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Functional-document authoring: ADR, PRD, SPEC, LLD, PLAN, ROADMAP, TICKET, TASK — standards, maker, review, validator, eight type templates, and file-bug (capture -> classify -> record -> dispatch -> write-back for bug reports). Also covers research/measurement (research-methods, make-rubric), markdown↔markup conversion (markdown-to-markup, html-to-markdown), knowledge/reference authoring (make-reference, make-llms-txt, make-vision-memo — knowledge-pack authoring lives in harness's make-pack), and a fresh-context doc-checker agent alongside the experiment-runner agent.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: The foundational authoring plugin, self-contained: maker/standards/lint families for skills, agents, hooks, and entry files; the absorbed language layer (prompt-wording-rules), intent extraction, and two-plane decomposition; /check-everything as the recurring outer loop.

plugins.name: llm
plugins.description: Portable LLM-integration and chat-agent-harness knowledge, project-agnostic: the swappable-provider gateway pattern, streaming structured output over JSONL/SSE, and the six-layer construction of a mini/portable chat-agent harness (instructions/guardrails, skills/routing, orchestration/workflows, knowledge/memory, tools/resources/services, observability). Distilled from @agent-ui/a2ui's live-agent implementation and Claude Code's own current harness mechanics, taught as general technique rather than a repo-specific answer pack.

plugins.name: screens
plugins.description: Design and critique UI structure (layouts, flows, components, patterns) and verify it against non-functional bars (focus, i18n, perf, safety) — plus check-ui-change, which drives the live artifact instead of reasoning about it in the abstract.

plugins.name: teamwork
plugins.description: Derive decisions, design composition/continuation patterns, and run a multi-agent feature-delivery team end to end.
